title: I Found a SECRET in the MSFS 2024 Update... (Reno Air Races)
description:
Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Sim Update 5 is almost here, but we have some breaking news regarding a delay and a massive hidden gem discovered in the activity section. In this video, we dive into the MSFS 2024 Sim Update 5 release date and why the team decided to push it back to next week.

While exploring the Sim Update 5 preview, I discovered a major leak: The National Championship Air Races (Reno Air Races) are returning to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024! This fan-favorite MSFS expansion was a staple in the 2020 version, and now it appears as a locked item in the MSFS 2024 activity menu.

Is this a surprise MSFS 2024 DLC launch? We’ve seen this before with the Red Bull Air Race and Stranger Things crossovers. Can't wait till Sim Update 5 will be released and we when this hidden gem is unlocked.
